definitions.unanswered_questions: C1a candidates: a message with '?' whose addressees send nothing later
definitions.ignored_questions: C1b candidates: [question, reply] where the reply shares no content word with it
definitions.near_duplicates: C4a/C4b candidates: [id, id, difflib ratio >= 0.9, both status-like], same sender
definitions.speech_acts_keyword: the keyword baseline of the speech acts, beside the judge's
definitions.resource_division_candidates: [message, reply, file]: a file and a line range answered with not/won't/avoid
definitions.negotiation_candidates: [message, reply]: options (1) and (2) with a question, answered by a choice
definitions.contradictions: C3a and Broken commitment candidates: a done/added/implemented claim naming an identifier the sender's patch lacks or a file it never touches
definitions.overlapping_hunks: Work overlap signal: hunks of two patches on one file with meeting base line ranges
definitions.insertion_markers: App D: added comment lines marking where another agent inserts code
definitions.missing_final_status: App D: agents whose last message precedes their last edit, or who sent none after it
definitions.git_disasters: coordbench's label for git-failures.json's git_disasters: force pushes and hard resets
definitions.git_broken: coordbench's label for broken: a push followed by a failing test run
definitions.git_impatience: coordbench's label for impatience: fetches before the partner's first push
definitions.git_destructive: coordbench's label for destructive: a commit deleting 100 or more lines of a file the partner changed (from git log --stat, approximate when the bar is scaled)
